title: 1000 cubes and resolved heavy sphere

governing_assumptions: Same pure ABD solver and device block preconditioner as current runs.

geometry.description: Exactly 1000 cubes in 10x10x10 grid and one 2562-vertex, 5120-triangle icosphere

discretization.refinement_plan: Full-size CUDA capacity gate before production; no silent coarsening.

materials.name: cube
materials.provenance: Numerical orthogonality penalty for near-rigid impact; validated on CUDA/f64 through the requested0.25s endpoint.

materials.provenance: Numerical orthogonality penalty for near-rigid impact; validated on CUDA/f64 through the requested0.25s endpoint.

boundary_conditions.description: bottom and y side walls as existing case

time.stability_policy: Nominal1e-3s; recoverable failures roll back and halve dt, at most2retries per step, global minimum nominal/4; accepted increments sum from the recorded start_time to the target time. All convergence thresholds remain authoritative.

estimates.candidate_counts: Initial separated grid is small; settled/colliding counts must be measured by full-size CUDA gate and production overflow checks.

capacities.policy: Stop and retain failure on overflow/OOM; never drop contacts or change mesh to fit.

validation.expectation: Exactly1000cubes+one sphere;finite and feasible;ball x displacement>0.05m;>10cubes move>0.01m;near-rigid principal stretches within1%.
validation.tolerance: target time1e-8s; fixed Newton velocity0.05m/s; case-specific PCG absolute1e-10, checked against independent surface-velocity error
validation.evidence: Completed CUDA/f64 trajectory:250accepted1ms steps,zero retries,1000cubes moved>0.01m,ball x displacement0.663510546m,maximum principal-stretch deviation3.872070917e-5,minimum affine volume ratio0.9999633605. Positive PT/EE and wall gaps and initial mechanical-proxy budget checked at every accepted step.
validation.timestep_policy: Nominal1e-3s; recoverable failures roll back and halve dt, at most2retries per step, global minimum nominal/4; accepted increments sum from the recorded start_time to the target time. All convergence thresholds remain authoritative.

assumptions: SI units; preserve material/contact laws and f64 precision. Fixed Newton0.05m/s and PCG absolute1e-10; the mass-norm bound at minimum dt limits linear surface-velocity error to1.2e-3m/s. Historical captured-matrix evidence used Newton1e-7 and PCG1e-13.
Sphere keeps old circumscribed radius and density; mesh refinement changes faceted volume and mass.

User-requested endpoint0.25s. Validated nominal1e-3s without retries; bounded recorded timestep reduction remains available for numerical failures. E2TPa is a numerical orthogonality penalty, distinct from fixed contact kappa1e12.
The initial-budget proxy is kinetic+orthogonality+floor-relative gravity and omits nonnegative IPC barrier energy; it is not a complete energy-conservation certificate.
